dumps.//: ADR-0004 §3 / issue #23 — THE regeneration target for the D1–D4 CardAtlas dumps. REPOINTED: the CardAtlas flow was forked into libs/atlas-flows AND tests/magic-ast-tests and the copies diverged (the libs copy regressed `side`/intercept + the ADR-0003 structured facets). The owner's decision was to make the tests copy the single source of truth, so this target now drives the `mast` project (tests/magic-ast-tests) end-to-end rather than the deleted libs CardAtlas flow. It runs the four stages in dependency order — ParseCorpus (Scryfall bulk → card-inputs.json + parse-records.json, the slow ~49 s corpus parse), FetchCombos (CSB variants dump → combos.json), CardAtlas (D1–D4 dumps under _08_Reporting/dumps/), RankComboAnchors (combo-anchor-report.json under _08_Reporting/dumps/) — then PUBLISHES the produced dumps to the repo-root gitignored `dumps/` (the known path the atlas-api seeder reads: Atlas:*Path in apps/atlas-api/appsettings.json). Consumers never fall back to a committed copy: they fail loudly naming this target. Bonus: the mast harness carries the StepCodeIdentity cache-keying fix (ADR-0004 #22) the libs harness lacked, so this path is no longer code-blind. The target id stays `flowthru:dumps` so every consumer error message and doc that names it keeps resolving. Only the LEAF dumps are copied — no upstream artifact is rewritten, which matters because Flowthru fingerprints file items on mtime:size, not content (flowthru#148).
